intended_use: Local portfolio MLOps prototype for estimating customer churn risk as decision support; it must not automatically determine customer treatment.
provenance_note: The raw dataset is not stored in Git, and the model artifact is not stored in Git. This manifest's artifact_sha256 is the authoritative integrity value for the planned deployment artifact. Joblib/pickle artifacts must only be loaded after their provenance and integrity have been verified. The model-v1.0.0 release is planned and has not yet been published.
